text: SSC Napoli's 2026/27 centenary home jersey integrates the logo of the club's Main Partner MSC, its Global Technical Partner EA7, its Back-of-Shirt Partner Sorgesana, and its Sleeve Partner Dongfeng.
short: Napoli 2026/27 home jersey: MSC main, Sorgesana back, Dongfeng sleeve.

source.name: SSC Napoli - SSC Napoli and EA7 unveil the 2026/27 Home Jersey
source.quote: The jersey also elegantly integrates the logo of the club's Main Partner, MSC, its Global Technical Partner, EA7, its Back-of-Shirt Partner, Sorgesana, and its Sleeve Partner, Dongfeng.
